name: DOF multiplane capture check
description: Verification fixture for ADR-0027 depth-of-field plane capture (epic task 2). Paper Surface (focal plane, z 0.0) behind a lower-third Overlay (z 0.7), with a depth-of-field Effect present so the engine takes the multiplane path: capture each layer as a separate plane and composite back-to-front. Task 2 composites with no blur (the zero-defocus base case) — the bokeh disc kernel lands in task 3. Use window.__hivizDofPreviewPlane = 'surface' | 'overlay' | 'composite' to screenshot each plane in isolation.

content.title: Focal plane
content.body:
The paper card sits at the focal plane (z 0.0) — it stays sharp.

The lower-third overlay sits at z 0.7, the defocus plane, behind the lens of a future bokeh pass.
